description: iSpot TV conversion GIFs on pt.ispot.tv/v2, whose site ID rides in the path as TC-####-#. Impression GIFs on pi.ispot.tv stay vendor/ispot. The type query names the conversion event.

params.name: tracking_code
params.description: It is the Site ID on the TV conversion pixel. iSpot documents it as TC-XXXX-X.
params.fix_hint: Put the Site ID from iSpot in the path so it reads /v2/TC-{account}-{site}.gif.

params.name: type
params.description: It names the conversion event. iSpot documents that conversion pixels are differentiated by the type field.
params.fix_hint: Send type as the conversion event name iSpot configured for this pixel.
